# Code of Conduct

## The short version

Be good to one another. Disagree on ideas, not people. Don't be a jerk.

## What that means in practice

- Give feedback on the work, not the person.
- Assume good faith — most disagreements are misunderstandings, not attacks.
- Harassment, personal insults, and deliberately derailing discussions with
  unrelated arguments aren't welcome here.
- Keep issues, PRs, and discussions focused on <<project name>>.

## Enforcement

If someone's behavior is making this project unpleasant to work on, contact
the maintainers via a GitHub issue or private message to a maintainer.
Maintainers will look into it and take whatever action fits — a heads-up,
a warning, or a ban from project spaces (GitHub issues/PRs/discussions)
for repeat or serious offenses.

## Scope

Applies to all project spaces on GitHub — issues, PRs, and discussions.
